note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_Licence (sql/v2/23_usp_Insights_Dimension_Licence_v2.sql) as deployed. Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. Licences are counted as of today (no report period). Active, Expired and every other status column are the licence's latest status exactly as the Status column of RegTrack's own licence report shows it - not worked out from the end date.
setup: DECLARE @UserID INT = {UserID};
DECLARE @CustomerID INT = {CustomerID};
DECLARE @AsOf DATETIME = GETDATE();
-- Step 1. Licences at the company's operating branches (Lic_tbl_LicenseInstance, not deleted), narrowed by the
--         user's licence role (User.LicenseRoleID -> Role.Code), the same rule RegTrack's own licence report uses:
--         Company Admin (CADMN) sees all; Management/Auditor (MGMT/AUDT) only their LIC_EntitiesAssignment
--         (branch, licence type) pairs; Non-Admin (EXCT) only licences on compliance tasks assigned to them.
DECLARE @LicRole VARCHAR(10) = (SELECT r.Code FROM [User] u JOIN Role r ON r.ID = u.LicenseRoleID WHERE u.ID = @UserID AND u.IsDeleted = 0);
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lic') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lic;
--         A perpetual licence (IsPermanantActive = 1) has no expiry: its end date is ignored (blanked here, as RegTrack's own
--         licence report does), so it never counts as ending in the next 30 days.
SELECT li.ID AS LicenseId, li.CustomerBranchID AS BranchID, NULLIF(li.LicenseTypeID, -1) AS LicenseTypeID,
CASE WHEN ISNULL(li.IsPermanantActive, 0) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE li.EndDate END AS EndDate,
CAST(ISNULL(li.IsPermanantActive, 0) AS INT) AS IsPerpetual INTO #lic
FROM Lic_tbl_LicenseInstance li
WHERE li.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND li.IsDeleted = 0
AND li.CustomerBranchID IN (SELECT cb.ID FROM CustomerBranch cb WHERE cb.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND cb.IsDeleted = 0 AND cb.Status = 1)
AND (@LicRole = 'CADMN'
OR (@LicRole IN ('MGMT', 'AUDT') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LIC_EntitiesAssignment ea
WHERE ea.UserID = @UserID AND ea.BranchID = li.CustomerBranchID AND ea.LicenseTypeID = li.LicenseTypeID))
OR (@LicRole = 'EXCT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Lic_tbl_LicenseComplianceInstanceScheduleOnMapping m
JOIN ComplianceAssignment ca ON ca.ComplianceInstanceID = m.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE m.LicenseID = li.ID AND ca.UserID = @UserID)))
--         ...and only licences whose linked compliance task is live: the schedule the licence's latest status
--         points at is mapped to it, active, has an active performer (ComplianceAssignment RoleID 3) and has
--         been acted on at least once (a ComplianceTransaction row exists) - the same rule RegTrack's report uses.
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Lic_tbl_LicenseComplianceInstanceScheduleOnMapping m
JOIN ComplianceScheduleOn cso ON cso.ID = m.ComplianceScheduleOnID AND cso.IsActive = 1 AND cso.IsUpcomingNotDeleted = 1
JOIN ComplianceAssignment ca ON ca.ComplianceInstanceID = m.ComplianceInstanceID AND ca.RoleID = 3
JOIN [User] pu ON pu.ID = ca.UserID AND pu.IsDeleted = 0 AND pu.IsActive = 1 AND pu.CustomerID = @CustomerID
WHERE m.LicenseID = li.ID
AND m.ComplianceScheduleOnID IN (SELECT lst.ComplianceScheduleOnID FROM Lic_tbl_LicenseStatusTransaction lst
JOIN Lic_tbl_StatusMaster lsm ON lsm.ID = lst.StatusID
WHERE lst.LicenseID = li.ID AND lst.IsActive = 1
AND lst.CreatedOn = (SELECT MAX(l2.CreatedOn) FROM Lic_tbl_LicenseStatusTransaction l2 WHERE l2.LicenseID = li.ID))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ComplianceTransaction ct WHERE ct.ComplianceScheduleOnID = m.ComplianceScheduleOnID));
-- Step 2. Each licence's latest status as RegTrack's own licence report reads it (RecentLicenseTransactionView):
--         the Lic_tbl_LicenseStatusTransaction row with the newest CreatedOn (IsActive = 1), and the label RegTrack's
--         report shows for that status id (status dictionary InsightsEnumPolarity, Semantic = LicenceReportStatus -
--         by id, because status names have whitespace duplicates).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#status') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #status;
WITH mx AS (SELECT lst.LicenseID, MAX(lst.CreatedOn) AS Dated FROM Lic_tbl_LicenseStatusTransaction lst
JOIN #lic l ON l.LicenseId = lst.LicenseID GROUP BY lst.LicenseID),
ranked AS (SELECT lst.LicenseID, lst.StatusID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lst.LicenseID ORDER BY lst.ID DESC) AS rn
FROM Lic_tbl_LicenseStatusTransaction lst JOIN mx ON mx.LicenseID = lst.LicenseID AND mx.Dated = lst.CreatedOn
WHERE lst.IsActive = 1),
lbl AS (SELECT TRY_CAST(p.RawValue AS INT) AS StatusId, p.Meaning AS Label
FROM dbo.InsightsEnumPolarity p JOIN dbo.InsightsDictionaryVersion v ON v.VersionId = p.VersionId AND v.IsCurrent = 1
WHERE p.Semantic = 'LicenceReportStatus' AND TRY_CAST(p.RawValue AS INT) IS NOT NULL)
SELECT l.LicenseId, b.Label INTO #status
FROM #lic l LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.LicenseID = l.LicenseId AND r.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN lbl b ON b.StatusId = r.StatusID;
-- Keep today's date for the checks below (each check runs on its own).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#asof') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #asof;
SELECT @AsOf AS AsOf INTO #asof;

checks.name: Licences in the report
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic;

checks.name: Licences with a licence type
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic WHERE LicenseTypeID IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Overall Expired share (%)
checks.tables: Licences with a licence type whose RegTrack status is Expired / ALL licences (typed or not) x 100 - exactly as the procedure does it.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.LicenseTypeID IS NOT NULL AND s.Label = N'Expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId;

checks.name: Licence types that have licences
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LicenseTypeID) AS Value FROM #lic WHERE LicenseTypeID IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Active licences (RegTrack status)
checks.tables: Licences with a licence type whose RegTrack status is Active.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID IS NOT NULL AND s.Label = N'Active';

checks.name: Expired licences (RegTrack status)
checks.tables: Licences with a licence type whose RegTrack status is Expired.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID IS NOT NULL AND s.Label = N'Expired';

checks.name: A licence type's licences
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic WHERE LicenseTypeID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A licence type's licences with RegTrack status Active
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND s.Label = N'Active';

checks.name: A licence type's licences with RegTrack status Expired
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND s.Label = N'Expired';

checks.name: A licence type's licences with RegTrack status Expiring
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND s.Label = N'Expiring';

checks.name: A licence type's licences with RegTrack status Applied
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId

query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId

query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND s.Label = N'Rejected';

checks.name: A licence type's licences with RegTrack status Application Rejected
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND s.Label = N'Application Rejected';

checks.name: A licence type's licences with RegTrack status Terminated
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND s.Label = N'Terminated';

checks.name: A licence type's licences with RegTrack status Not Applicable
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND s.Label = N'Not Applicable';

checks.name: A licence type's licences with any other RegTrack status
checks.tables: Step 2 label = Draft, Registered, Registered & Renewal Filed or Validity Expired.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND s.Label IN (N'Draft', N'Registered', N'Registered & Renewal Filed', N'Validity Expired');

checks.name: A licence type's licences ending in the next 30 days
checks.tables: Not perpetual; end date after today and within 30 days.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic CROSS JOIN #asof a WHERE LicenseTypeID = {RowKey}
AND EndDate > a.AsOf AND EndDate <= DATEADD(DAY, 30, a.AsOf);

checks.name: Locations holding a licence type
checks.tables: Distinct CustomerBranch of this type's licences.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BranchID) AS Value FROM #lic WHERE LicenseTypeID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A licence type's Expired share (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Label = N'Expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #lic l JOIN #status s ON s.LicenseId = l.LicenseId WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey};
